goodToKnow: Der Staatssekretär (die Staatssekretärin) ranks just below a minister. Germany has two kinds: the beamteter Staatssekretär, a senior civil servant who runs a ministry day to day, and the parlamentarischer Staatssekretär, a member of the Bundestag who supports the minister politically, much like a junior minister. Don't confuse it with a secretary who manages an office, which is die Sekretärin. Note the double s: Staat + s + Sekretär.
